## Instructions

Northwestern University's Knight Lab wanted to help sharpen users' database skills, so they created a murder mystery. Can you solve this crime in SQL City??

The relational data you will be working with contains tables with different pieces of information pertinent to the crime - people, social media check-ins, driver's licenses, crime scene reports, police interviews, and more!

![Database schema](https://mystery.knightlab.com/schema.png)



## Access the Data

This code chunk will read in all of the tables of data for you. Don't modify or remove this!

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/manncz/stat-331-s25/main/labs/lab5/data/bCH_murder_data.Rdata") |> 
  load()
```

## Clean and Combine the Data

Let's set ourselves up to solve this crime lickity-split!

**0.1 Use a `stringr` function(s) and a regular expression(s) to create `address_number` and `address_street_name` columns in the `person` dataset. Convert the `address_number` variable to numeric.**

```{r}
# code for Q0.1
person <- person |>
  mutate(address_number = str_extract(address, pattern = "\\d+")) |>
  mutate(address_number = as.numeric(address_number)) |>
  mutate(address_street_name = str_extract(address, pattern = "[:alpha:].*"))
```

**0.2 Design and implement a check that you created the `address_number` and `address_street_name` columns correctly.**

:::callout-tip
# Hint
For example, if you re-combine the `address_number` and `address_street_name` columns, you should get the same value as original `address` column exactly.
:::

```{r}
# code for Q0.2
kable(str_c(person$address_number[1], " ", person$address_street_name[1]) == person$address[1] )
```

**0.3 Create two new datasets:**

- `get_fit_now_full`
  - every row represents one visit to the "Get Fit Now" gym. 
  - all member information is included (e.g. check in times, names, and membership information)
  - should have 2,703 rows and 8 columns

- `suspects_all`
  - each row represents one person
  - includes their address, driver's licence information, income, and interview with the police, if they have one
  - drop the `address` column
  - should have 10,011 rows and 16 columns

  
```{r}
# code to create get_fit_now_full
get_fit_now_full <- 
  full_join( get_fit_now_check_in, get_fit_now_member, by = join_by("membership_id" == "id")) 

```


```{r}
# code to create suspects_all
suspects_all <-
  full_join(person, interview, by = join_by("id" == "person_id")) |>
  full_join(income, by = "ssn") |>
  left_join(drivers_license, by = join_by("license_id" == "id")) |>
  select(-address)

```
  
  
## Solve the Crime

### Crime Scene Report

Detective Wickham reaches out to you...

> A crime has taken place and I need your help! There was a murder in SQL City sometime on Jan.15, 2018. Could you retrieve the crime scene report from the police department’s database and follow the clues to find the person responsible for the murder?!

### Filtering the Crime

```{r}
crime_filtered <- crime_scene_report |>
  mutate(date = ymd(date)) |>
  filter(date == ymd("2018-01-15")) |>
  filter(type == "murder") |>
  filter(city == "SQL City")
```

### Description of Crime

```{r}
crime_filtered$description |> kable()
```
### Finding the Witnesses

```{r}
witness_1 <- suspects_all |>
  filter(address_street_name == "Northwestern Dr") |>
  filter(!is.na(transcript)) |>
  arrange(desc(address_number)) |>
  head(1) 

witness_2 <- suspects_all |>
  filter(address_street_name == "Franklin Ave") |>
  filter(str_detect(name, "Annabel")) 
```

### Witness 1's Testimony

```{r}
witness_1$transcript |> kable()
```
### Witness 2's Testimony

```{r}
witness_2$transcript |> kable()
```
### Finding the Criminal from the Testimonies

```{r}
# Testimony from witness 2 doesn't help as the two filtered suspects have the same check in date at line 3
criminal <- get_fit_now_full |>
  filter(membership_status == "gold") |>
  filter(str_detect(membership_id, pattern = "^48Z")) |>
  inner_join(suspects_all, by = join_by("person_id" == "id")) |>
  filter(str_detect(plate_number, pattern = "H42W"))
```

### The "Criminal's" Testimony

```{r}
criminal$transcript |> kable()
```


### Who Hired Jeremy Bowers???

```{r}
woman <- suspects_all |>
  filter(gender == "female") |>
  filter(hair_color == "red") |>
  filter(height >= 65 & height <= 67) |>
  filter(car_make == "Tesla") |>
  filter(car_model == "Model S") |>
  filter(annual_income > 0)

event <- facebook_event_checkin |>
  filter(event_name == "SQL Symphony Concert") |>
  mutate(date = ymd(date)) |>
  filter(year(date) == 2017) |>
  filter(month(date) == 12)

inner_join(woman, event, by = join_by("id" == "person_id")) |>
  kable()


```


::: callout-note

## And the final suspect is...

*Miranda Priestly*

:::
